name: Cloud & Infrastructure
oneLiner: Turns racks of chips into rentable, schedulable clusters for training and serving models.

analogy.text: A utility company: you plug in and pay for what you use, without owning the power plant.
analogy.breaks: Unlike electricity, AI capacity isn't interchangeable: specific chips, network layouts and regions matter, and capacity can simply be unavailable.

givesAbove: On-demand clusters, storage and networking that teams can train and serve models on.
needsBelow: Accelerators and interconnect from Compute Hardware, housed and powered by Physical & Energy.
